name: NO TURN ON RED
spec: white vertical rectangle with black legend NO TURN ON RED
meaning: Wait for a green light before turning, even if the way is clear.

snippets.back: Where a NO TURN ON RED sign is posted at a signal-controlled intersection, you may not turn right or left on a red light.
Look for No Turn On Red signs before you turn right at a red light.
A No Turn on Red notice prohibits the red-light turn discussed in the handbook's circular-red guidance.
Where a right turn on red is allowed, you must stop fully, check that no vehicles or pedestrians are in or entering your path, confirm there is no No Turn on Red sign, and use the correct lane.
A No Turn On Red sign bars both left and right turns until green.
A No Turn on Red sign forbids a right turn during the red phase, so the driver must wait for green.
A right turn on red is allowed only after stopping and yielding to pedestrians and other traffic, and is forbidden when a No Turn on Red sign is posted.
Regulatory examples in the manual include signs that ban right turns, left turns, U-turns or all turns, plus Left Turn Only, Do Not Enter, Wrong Way, No Parking, No Turn on Red and Do Not Pass.
